title: Tate coefficient generator from the normalized root class
statement: Let $k$ be algebraically closed, let $N$ be nonzero in $k$, and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $N=0$ in $A$. Put $P=\mathbf P^1_k$, let $\delta\in H^2(P,\mu_N)$ be the actual Kummer boundary of $\mathcal O(1)$, and let $\kappa=\operatorname{ordinaryFiniteP1KummerClass}$ be its scalar extension to the finite Tate line $L=A(1)_P$ [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class]. Assume an additive isomorphism $e:H^2(P,\mu_N)\simeq\mathbf Z/N$ sends $\delta$ to one. Then $a\mapsto H^2(U(a\,\mathrm{id}_L))(\kappa)$ is a bijection $A\to H^2(P,U(L))$, where $U$ forgets module coefficients.

source.place: Geometric-fibre Kummer-class calculation and finite coefficient extension

proof.text: A primitive root identifies the root sheaf with constant Z/N. Transport the supplied additive normalization through this identification: the resulting constant-coefficient class theta generates H^2(P,Z/N). Apply the finite constant-coefficient generator theorem to the additive group of A. A primitive root also trivializes the finite Tate line over A. Its line universal property identifies arbitrary root-to-line coefficient maps with endomorphisms of that line; all such endomorphisms are scalars on the connected projective line, by the adopted constant rank-one endomorphism lemma. Naturality transfers the coefficient generator to the scalar orbit of kappa. This orbit is therefore surjective, and the same coefficient identification gives the target cardinality card(A), so finite cardinality makes it bijective. No flatness of A over Z/N is required.

theorem ordinaryFiniteP1KummerClass_scalar_bijective_of_normalization
    (N : ℕ) (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (hNk : (N : k) ≠ 0)
    (hP : IsUnit (N : Γ(ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k)), ⊤)))
    (hNorm : ∃ e :
      Sheaf.H ((ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k))).rootsOfUnitySheaf N) 2 ≃+ ZMod N,
      e ((ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k))).kummerδ₁ N hP
        (Scheme.Pic.toCohomologicalPicardGroup (ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k)))
          (Scheme.Pic.ofIsInvertible
            (ProjectiveSpace.twist (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (.of k)) 1)))) = 1) :
    Function.Bijective (fun a : A ↦ Sheaf.H.map
      ((moduleAbelianForget A (ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k)))).map
        (a • 𝟙 (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine (ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k))) N A hA))) 2
      (ordinaryFiniteP1KummerClass A N hA (Spec (.of k)) hP))
